candidates.explanation: toPersistence assigns persistenceEntity.lastName = domainEntity.firstName instead of domainEntity.lastName. Every create and update that goes through this mapper therefore writes the first name into the lastName column. That is why new registrations and later profile edits both end up with last name equal to first name.

fix.description: Map lastName from the domain entity's lastName.
